volume.interpretation: Page ratio measures retained input reduction, not an achieved end-to-end cost saving. Entire originals were downloaded and native-extracted before reviewer boundary selection; full-source discovery/segmentation cost remains.

automation_limits: The prepared48 queries and returned search order were recorded, but candidate relevance, publisher-link traversal, access triage, strata assignment and notice selection required agent judgment. No unattended discovery recall was evaluated.

Boundary selection was reviewer-guided using native text and rendered originals; pypdf copying, pdftotext extraction, rendering, hashes and page maps were mechanical. The frozen pipeline receives preselected pages, so its scores cannot establish automatic full-register segmentation accuracy.
Five full_notice inputs include some manually delimited standalone notices inside packets/registers; full_notice describes collection scope, not automated target detection.

Five unknown inputs retain multiple notices or record components, and two slice inputs retain complete cover forms from larger packages. No implicit target resolution or whole-original absence guarantee follows.
Four publisher scans carry embedded OCR and are concentrated in two related state filing families. No image-only-without-text-layer coverage is established.
Queries were completed before queued candidate processing ended; the primary accepted this disclosed search-order deviation for diagnostic use. Frozen source records were not rewritten.
The ledger is not a complete per-tool stopwatch or billing log. Query timestamps can reflect persistence time and parallel downloads prevent summing wall-clock intervals as active labor.

cost_accounting.note: Unknown costs remain null. This audit performs no new searches, downloads, models, parsers or pipeline runs; it reads existing diagnostics only.
